clips.title: The story
paras: Incendia Agave is a rare, spiky aquatic plant native to the Boiling Pool beneath Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles. When enchanted by a skilled shaman, its unique properties allow it to kindle the sacred fire of life.

Growing beneath and around the waters of the Boiling Pool in Thousand Needles, Incendia Agave thrives directly in the shadow of Darkcloud Pinnacle. Guarded naturally by wandering steam elementals, the plant is difficult to harvest and scarce across Kalimdor. Despite growing submerged in water, it contains potent natural elements that lend themselves directly to rituals of flame.
